Job Title: Head – Finance & Accounts (Chartered Accountant)

Location: Pune – MH

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Level: 10–15 years

About the Company

DDE ULTRA is a pioneering provider of ultra-high purity process utility systems serving the semiconductor, PV Solar and other high-tech industries. We specialize in designing, manufacturing and installing complex utility systems and turnkey solutions.

We are seeking an Experienced Chartered Accountant (CA) to independently lead the complete Finance & Accounts function, ensuring financial control, compliance, accurate reporting, effective cost management and sound financial decision-making.

Key Responsibilities
• Take end-to-end ownership of accounting, finance operations, monthly and annual book closures, and finalization of accounts.
• Prepare and review financial statements, cash-flow reports, MIS and management dashboards, present key financial insights to senior management.
• Lead annual budgeting, periodic budget forecasting and financial planning across departments and projects.
• Conduct budget-versus-actual variance analysis, investigate deviations and recommend corrective actions.
• Manage cost control and optimization, including project costs, material, manpower, overheads and operating expenses; monitor cost overruns and profitability.
• Oversee cash flow, working capital, fund planning, receivables, payables, banking relationships and facilities such as BGs and LCs, wherever applicable.
• Manage direct and indirect taxation, including GST, TDS and income tax, ensuring timely filings, reconciliations and resolution of notices.
• Lead statutory, internal and tax audits; coordinate with auditors and consultants and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
• Oversee project accounting, project-wise costing, billing, revenue recognition, work-in-progress, retention and profitability reporting.
• Establish and strengthen financial policies, internal controls, approval mechanisms, accounting procedures and compliance calendars.
• Lead and guide the Accounts & Finance team, review deliverables and ensure timely and accurate completion of activities.
• Coordinate with projects, procurement, stores, HR, sales and other teams on budgets, costs, collections, payments and financial matters.

Technical Skills
• Strong knowledge of accounting standards, financial reporting, finalization of accounts and taxation.
• Expertise in budgeting, forecasting, budget-versus-actual variance analysis and cost management.
• Strong understanding of cash flow, treasury, working capital, project costing and profitability analysis.
• Hands-on experience in GST, TDS, income tax, statutory compliance and audit management.
• Knowledge of internal financial controls, risk management and financial process improvement.
• Proficiency in ERP / SAP / Tally and advanced MS Excel; ability to prepare MIS and management reports.

If you are GREAT in the above, not just good, then we need you in our Team.

Qualifications & Skills
• Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).
• 10–15 years of relevant post-qualification experience in Finance & Accounts, preferably in engineering, manufacturing, EPC or project-based organizations.
• Demonstrated ability to independently manage the complete finance function, including accounting, taxation, audits, banking and statutory compliance.
• Proven experience in annual budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, cost control and project profitability management.
• Experience in financial reporting, cash-flow and working-capital management, internal controls and team leadership.
• Strong analytical, decision-making, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with high integrity and accountability.

Preferred Industry Background
• Engineering, manufacturing and industrial organizations.
• Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) companies.
• Project-based engineering, infrastructure and turnkey solution providers.
• Semiconductor, PV Solar, process engineering and industrial utility industries.

Additional Information
• This is a senior-level role with independent ownership of the organization's Finance & Accounts function.
• The candidate must combine hands-on financial management with leadership-level planning, reporting and decision support.
• Experience in managing finance for a growing engineering, manufacturing or EPC business will be an advantage.

We are looking to build a dedicated to support a leading alternative investment / private markets client. The team will collectively support end-to-end Credit Finance and Client Reporting activities, ensuring seamless service delivery and stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities

Credit Finance Operations

• Perform end-to-end accounting and finance activities for private credit and alternative investment funds.
• Maintain loan portfolios, investment schedules, and debt instrument records.
• Process loan drawdowns, repayments, interest accruals, fee calculations, and covenant-related activities.
• Support monthly, quarterly, and annual fund closes.
• Reconcile cash, loan positions, investment balances, and general ledger accounts.
• Prepare and validate NAV-related calculations and supporting schedules.
• Assist with audit requests and regulatory reporting requirements.
• Ensure adherence to client-specific accounting policies and internal control frameworks.

Client Reporting

• Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual investor/client reporting packages.
• Generate portfolio performance reports, exposure analyses, capital activity summaries, and management reports.
• Perform data validation and quality checks before report distribution.
• Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to gather reporting inputs.
• Support ad-hoc reporting requests from clients and senior management.
• Ensure reporting accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery against agreed SLAs.

Data & Systems Management

• Reconcile information across accounting systems, portfolios, and reporting platforms.
• Identify process improvement opportunities and support automation initiatives.
• Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure data integrity across systems.
• Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Commerce, or related disciplines.
• Professional qualifications such as CA, CPA, CFA, or MBA Finance will be an advantage.

Experience

• 4-7 years of relevant experience in credit finance, fund accounting, and client reporting.
• Strong understanding of private credit and investment operations.

Technical Skills

• Strong working knowledge of Investran.
• Hands-on experience with Geneva.
• Fund accounting and investment accounting expertise.
• Credit finance and loan administration knowledge.

• Data reconciliation and reporting experience.
